input_scope: Only anonymous input.json: literal Lean statement and approved definition context. No source, proof, repository, history, or online search inspected.
compilation_boundary: Input marks statement compiled=true; this decoder has not independently compiled it.
hash_conventions: RAW SHA256 hashes exact file bytes; supplied packet hash is recorded as canonical packet identity, not equated with the input RAW hash.
start_time_scope: Timestamp recorded immediately after sole input inspection and before authoring the reconstruction.
self_hash_policy: This run file does not contain its own RAW hash. manifest.json contains its RAW hash. The manifest excludes itself and its RAW hash is reported externally, avoiding circular self-hashes.
canonical_run_payload_hash_policy: decoder_run_payload_sha256 hashes UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted keys of this object before that field is inserted. It is not the decoder-run.json RAW file hash.
